nativeContractSnapshot.current: Strict JSON-lines request variants include capture, register_content, content_chunk, finish_content, prepare, commit_write, paste(hostWindow+target), and cancel; unknown request fields are denied.

TypeScript NativeRequest mirrors the protocol and isNativeResult validates response fields plus requestId/generation/helperInstanceId correlation; no runtime NativeRequest encoder/validator is present.

READY has startup requestId/generation and helperInstanceId only. The instance id embeds PID and a nanosecond timestamp string, but READY does not separately bind helper PID and Windows process creation time as required by T03a.
The controller records the first request generation and returns stale_generation for every different generation; no generation reset/advance path was found.

Both current implementations require itemRef on prepare, while docs/spec/04-desktop-performance.md defines prepare with jobId/objectToken/expectedItemVersion only. Resolve this canonical-contract difference before host wiring.
